<a id="about"></a>

## 🤔 What is GPT Image 2.6?

OpenAI introduced Images 2.6 on November 4, 2026. This collection covers the Sunburst and Flare model variants, image creation and editing, plus documented SVG and GIF workflows. Variant support is recorded per case rather than assumed.

[Official announcement](https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6/) · [Model documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation)

## 📝 Full prompts

No full prompts are republished here yet. Case pages link to the actual original prompts when public and explicitly mark missing prompts. A source-link entry is not a copyable-prompt entry.

<a id="using"></a>

## 📚 How to use

1. Open a case from a category or featured card.
2. Read its model evidence, required inputs, source and reuse limits.
3. Follow the original prompt link when available. A missing prompt stays missing; do not infer it from an image.

<a id="contribute"></a>

## 🤝 How to contribute

Add main collection cases to content/source-cases.json and external website cases to external-sites/source-cases.json. Add complete prompts to content/prompts.json. The generator builds separate indexes and bilingual detail pages.

[Contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Source case and media guide](docs/SOURCE_CASES.md) · [Maintainer guide (Chinese)](docs/FILLING_GUIDE.zh-CN.md)
